 Hon'Ble Pankaj Bhatia, J. 
1.
Heard learned Counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2.  The present application has been filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail apprehending arrest in FIR No.256 of 2023, under Sections 376-D, 417, 342, 506 IPC, Police Station Bazarshukul, District Amethi.

3. This Court vide order dated 01.09.2025 passed the following order:
"1. Case called out.
None appears for the applicant.
2. Learned AGA for the State is present.
3. The interim anticipatory bail granted to the applicant vide order dated 1.2.2024 is not extended.
4. Learned court below is directed to proceed against the applicant as per law.

5. List this case on 7.10.2025.
6.

Office is directed to communicate this order to the concerned District Judge and submit a report by the next date of listing."
4.
In terms of the abovesaid orders, a report has been furnished to the effect that a charge-sheet has been filed and summons have been issued to the accused.
5. As the interim relief was granted only during the investigation, nothing survives in the matter.
It is left open to the applicant to take such steps as may be available to protect his right including the right to seek bail.
6. The anticipatory bail application is rejected.
(Pankaj Bhatia,J.) October 7, 2025 akverma  Pushpendra Tiwari Alias Prashant ... vs State Of U.P. Thru.
